topics.label: Владение и заимствование
topics.definition: Ownership, borrowing, moves, and borrow checking in Rust; exclude incidental use of these concepts.

topics.label: Времена жизни
topics.definition: Lifetime annotations, inference, elision, and relationships between lifetimes; exclude incidental references.

topics.label: Трейты и обобщения
topics.definition: Traits, trait implementations, bounds, generic programming, and associated items.

topics.label: Асинхронность и конкурентность
topics.definition: Async and await, futures, concurrent or parallel execution, synchronization, and related design.

topics.label: Система типов
topics.definition: Type checking, type inference, type relationships and type-system design; exclude mere use of a type.

topics.label: Обработка ошибок
topics.definition: Representing, propagating, recovering from, or reporting application errors and panics.

topics.label: Макросы
topics.definition: Declarative and procedural macros, expansion, hygiene and macro design.

topics.label: Unsafe и память
topics.definition: Unsafe Rust, memory safety, pointers, layout, aliasing or undefined behavior.

topics.label: Компилятор
topics.definition: Rust compiler implementation, compilation pipeline, diagnostics and compiler architecture; exclude generic language design alone.

topics.label: Библиотеки
topics.definition: Design, implementation, behavior, evolution or APIs of Rust libraries and crates, including the standard library and external libraries; exclude incidental use of a library.

topics.label: Cargo и инструменты
topics.definition: Cargo, package management, build tooling and developer tools such as rustfmt and clippy.

topics.label: Производительность
topics.definition: Performance measurement, optimization, runtime efficiency or compile-time performance; exclude unsupported incidental claims.

topics.label: Синтаксис и эргономика
topics.definition: Rust syntax, surface-language usability, readability and developer ergonomics.

topics.label: Развитие языка
topics.definition: Rust language governance, RFC process, stabilization, editions and language evolution as a process; exclude RFCs solely because they are RFCs.

topics.label: Модули и пути
topics.definition: Rust module system, paths, visibility, imports, and organization of modules and crates; exclude incidental use of imports or paths.

topics.label: Документация
topics.definition: Writing, organizing, generating or improving Rust documentation, including rustdoc and documentation tooling; exclude incidental documentation mentions.

topics.label: FFI и совместимость платформ
topics.definition: Foreign function interfaces, interoperability with other languages or native libraries, target platforms, platform-specific behavior, portability and cross-platform compatibility; exclude incidental platform mentions.
